mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_group WHERE group_id = #{groupId} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT g.group_id, g.group_name, g.group_code, g.description, g.status, g.create_time FROM sys_group g JOIN sys_user_group ug ON g.group_id = ug.group_id WHERE ug.user_id = #{userId} AND g.is_deleted = 0 AND g.status = 1 ORDER BY g.group_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_group (group_name, group_code, description, status) VALUES (#{groupName}, #{groupCode}, #{description}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_group SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user_group ug JOIN sys_user u ON ug.user_id = u.user_id WHERE ug.group_id = #{groupId} AND u.is_deleted = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sys_group_permission (group_id, perm_id) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{permId})
mapper.select: SELECT perm_id FROM sys_group_permission WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
